hints.title: Exact Match vs Displaced Frequency
hints.text: Bulls correspond to identical characters at identical positions. Cows correspond to matching characters present at mismatched indices.

hints.title: Single-Pass Counter Array
hints.text: When secret[i] equals guess[i], increment bulls. Otherwise, update separate frequency counters for unmatched secret digits and guess digits.

hints.title: Digit Minimum Overlap Summation
hints.text: For each digit 0 through 9, the cow contribution is min(secret_count[d], guess_count[d]). Format and return the count string as xAyB.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Double-counting digits between bulls and cows leads to overestimating cow tallies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed array of size 10 tracks digit counts in O(1) auxiliary space across a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should exclude exact bull matches prior to aggregating cow overlap frequencies.
